title: Present work and upcoming tours
summary: All star jazz band on college tours, Albany, and South Africa.

blocks.x: And you now live of course, in ....
Merrick, Long Island.
Merrick, Long Island. And we nned to know of course, what you are doing now. This
is all a little out of order perhaps, but we might as well throw it in here. And you're getting ready to go on the road? And you're be gone for about three months, right?
Right, an all star orchestra.
An all star orchestra.
Jazz band.
And you'll be playing.....
I'll be playing the colleges all over the Country.
All over the college circuit. Because that's a big demand, there's a big demand now for jazz bands you know.

They're very smart now in the colleges. They have their what do you call it, television closed circuit television. And we already did last May with Art Hodes in the band out there, we did concerts and they televised them and kept the tapes and put them in their archives which is quite smart. Because all the guys in the band are up there in years except the trombone player whose name is Jim Beebe. But the rest of the guys have been around for a number of years.
That's one of the reasons I want
to try to catch you in a concert myself if I can. (LAUGHTER).
All I really know are the names of the towns as yet. I don't know the names or the locations or which schools we're going to play. However, I will let you know. And then I go to Africa, by the way.
Oh come, tell me more about that.
Well I finish this, let's see, January, February, March with Art Hodes All Stars. And, did I mention the names before of the guys in the band? Yes, I said, Sam Stewart, one of the guys.
Yes, yes.

Jim BEEBE on trombone, Barney Bigard, Barrett Deems on drums, Art Hodes on piano and me on cornet. And we're do that for three months up until, January, February, March until the end of March. And May I go up to Albany, New York, I'll have Slam Stewart on bass and some little place up, I can't remember the name. It's in Albany for four weeks. That's May. June I haven't booked. But in July for six weeks for all of July and two weeks of August, I'll be going back to Durban, South Africa. So I'm practically booked outside of June, until next August.
Oh, that's marvellous. Oh, that's a comfortable feeling too isn't it? (LAUGHTER). And listen, this interview can possible take care of June. (LAUGHTER).
That's right, yes, indeed.
